summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of UKS Sokolik Niemodlin. 20/20 backend pytest cases passed against public preview URL. Frontend Playwright E2E validated public pages (Aktualnosci, Liga tabs, Turniej ranking+cards), admin login/logout, wrong-password error, and full CRUD for posts/players/matches/tournaments with public-page reflection and ranking auto-computation. All flows working; no critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Uses ObjectId(post_id) without try/except - malformed id would raise 500 instead of 400 (edge case, not exercised by UI)
No 404 check when id does not exist - update_one/delete_one silently succeed; returns null for post update (already gone case)
allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is browser-invalid per spec; not a runtime blocker since Bearer tokens are used, but should be an explicit origin list

issues: Polish diacritics render correctly. Orange+navy branding consistent. Contrast on navy hero and orange buttons is good.

action_items: (Optional) Add 400/404 handling in admin endpoints when ObjectId is malformed or resource does not exist
(Optional) Replace CORS wildcard with explicit origin list from env
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~420 line file - acceptable for MVP scope, no split needed yet
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (correct); JWT expiry 7 days is reasonable
MongoDB _id properly converted to 'id' via clean() helper; no ObjectId leaks
All admin routes protected by Depends(get_current_admin) - verified 401 on 5 endpoints without token
Ranking endpoint correctly aggregates cumulative points, tournaments count, best_placement across tournaments
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, Bearer token attached via axios interceptor, all interactive elements have data-testid
seed_data_creation: None persisted - all test data (TEST_* prefix) created and cleaned up via UI delete flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seeded on startup: 1 admin user + 3 posts + 5 players + 4 matches + 2 tournaments. Public API base is https://sokolik-ping-pong.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Regression pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, public reads, protected 401s, and full CRUD for all 4 entities including ranking auto-computation.
